S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  11.08.2023 ABA No.258 of 2023  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
In the present matter, the date of 09.10.2023 is already fixed for hearing on the Anticipatory Bail Application.

2. Heard Mr. Piyush Garg with Mr. Priyanshu Gairola, learned counsel for applicants and Mr. V.S.
Rathore, learned A.G.A. for State on Urgency Application.
3.

Present Application has been filed by the applicants-accused persons Rohit Kothari, Mohit Kothari and Sunil Joshi under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of Anticipatory Bail under Sections 498A, 354, 504 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 in connection with the Case Crime No.66 of 2023, registered at police station Doiwala, District Dehradun.
4. Applicant no.1 is the husband of the respondent no.2, informant/victim.
Applicant no.2 is the real brother of the applicant no.1 and applicant no.3 is the brother-in-law of the applicant no.1.
Applicant no.3 has been granted Interim Anticipatory Bail on 11.04.2023.

5. Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate submits that applicant no.1 undertakes that in case he is being granted Anticipatory Bail, he will present himself either personally or through virtually as and when required by the Investigating Officer and applicant no.2 also undertakes that he will cooperate with the Investigating Agency.

6. Issue notice to respondent no.2, informant/victim.
7.
Steps to be taken within 4 days.

8. List on 11.09.2023 for hearing on Anticipatory Bail Application.
9.

In the facts and circumstances of the case, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicants, namely, Rohit Kothari and Mohit Kothari, they will be released on Interim Anticipatory ABA/258/2023 on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161155829/
1 Bail on furnishing their personal bond of Rs. 30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer on the following conditions:-
(i) Applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person, acquainted with the facts of this case;
(ii) Applicants shall make themselves available for interrogation by the Investigating Agency.

10. It is clarified that if the applicants misuse or violate any of the conditions, imposed upon them,
the informant/victim or Investigating Officer will be free to move the Court for cancellation of Interim Anticipatory Bail.
11. The Urgency Application (IA No.02 of 2023) is disposed of accordingly.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 11.08.2023 Neha ABA/258/2023 on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161155829/
